limits: This is an independent-context mechanical and accounting review of retained records. It is not an independent semantic review of external originals, source passages, transfer principles, UI behavior or integration tests.

The minimum25 and direct/returned lineage counts18/52 rely on the root ledger's explicit canonical lineage assignments. Internal uniqueness and normalization preservation were checked, but authorship, mirrors and work-family boundaries were not re-established from originals.
A recorded source-original URL represents a source; it is not necessarily the literal retrieval URL. API/body fetches, tracking variants, redirects and aliases must not create extra original works.

No monetary cost, token cost, labor time or total-session tool-call equality was measured. The58 figure is the complete retained research-operation ledger, excluding local utility/file operations and any server-internal work.

Raw source and search response hashes/locators were retained but the full source responses were not reopened. Rank order and automatic exposure claims are therefore checked for record consistency, not independently reconstructed from original tool response bodies.
The naming issue in LA-07 remains visible in this fixed snapshot. A later display may clarify the definition; this audit does not alter the sealed counts or judgments.
The final Git contract check and remote result re-read are separate workflow gates. Reading these local Git objects does not replace those gates or prove current remote freshness.
The zero initial confirmed-fit result is an evidence state. Unread, inaccessible and semantically unresolved candidates are preserved and must not be converted into proven unsuitable candidates.
